title: Egomen
html_source:
Greek. As a rhetorical term means roughly “on the other hand” but could be literally translated “I, certainly.”

So, Stephen ruminates philosophically: Who helps to believe or, on the other hand, to unbelieve?

Also, Stephen assures himself: Who is an effective persuader? Me. Who is ineffective? The other guy.

Or perhaps: Who helps to believe? I Am. (YHWH) Who (helps) to unbelieve? The other chap (the devil.)
